text:
The image shows a large stainless steel mixing bowl, probably 25-30 cm across, holding cubed tofu, shredded or crumbled tofu or cheese, red onion, carrot, and a tahini or peanut-style sauce on top.

The food covers a region roughly 15 cm wide. Taking the layer as about 4-5 cm deep, the volume is around 600-700 ml, and since the pieces are loosely packed the mass comes to about 350 g.

For energy, tofu runs about 120 kcal per 100 g if firm. If part of it is actually cheese, the figure would be higher. About 250 g of tofu gives roughly 300 kcal. The sauce, at about 40 g, adds around 100 kcal, and the vegetables add about 30 kcal. That totals roughly 430 kcal.
